rows.culsma_evidence: The same lysate supplies the capture reaction and retained input fraction.
The declared buffer is reused when assembling the immunoprecipitation reaction.
The conjugated beads receive lysate, undergo binding, and enter capture separation.
The retained input fraction is later prepared for electrophoresis.
The collected flowthrough is later prepared for electrophoresis.
The retained captured beads are washed and then eluted.
The eluate is prepared and loaded into its gel lane.
The prepared input is loaded into the input lane.
The prepared flowthrough is loaded into the flowthrough lane.
The resolved gel is incorporated into the transfer stack.
The same transferred membrane is blocked, probed, washed, and imaged.

description: Named program objects are listed when they are introduced in one reviewed step and referenced in later steps.
